title: Suspension Limits, Resumption Notice and Standby Charges by Vending Services Program Programme
content:
A suspended Vending Services Program estate is governed by four figures printed against the programme the agreement is written at: the shortest suspension the programme accepts, the ceiling on suspended calendar days in one contract year, the notice needed to switch the machines back on, and the monthly charge for each machine while the estate stands suspended.

| Programme | Shortest suspension the programme accepts | Ceiling on suspended days in one contract year | Notice needed to switch the machines back on | Monthly standby charge for each machine |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Single Machine Snack Service | 7 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 3 calendar days | 25.00 |
| Snack & Cold Beverage Bank | 7 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 5 calendar days | 32.00 |
| Combination Vending Bank | 10 calendar days | 45 calendar days | 7 calendar days | 48.00 |
| Fresh Food Vending Service | 10 calendar days | 45 calendar days | 10 calendar days | 72.00 |
| Campus Vending Network Service | 14 calendar days | 60 calendar days | 14 calendar days | 55.00 |
| Managed Vending & Kiosk Service | 10 calendar days | 45 calendar days | 10 calendar days | 96.00 |

Every day figure is in calendar days. The standby charge is a monthly amount in US dollars and is stated for one machine.

### The floor and the ceiling read against one contract year

The first two figures bound a suspension from below and from above and are read against different spans. The floor is the length of a single suspension: on the Combination Vending Bank a suspension of 10 calendar days reaches the shortest the programme accepts, and one of 9 calendar days falls below it. The ceiling is the total of suspended calendar days in one contract year: on the same programme a contract year carrying 45 suspended days stands at the ceiling, and a further suspended day in that same contract year would carry it past the ceiling.

### The standby charge on an estate (hypothetical estate)

On an estate of three machines held at the Combination Vending Bank, where the standby charge printed against the programme is 48.00 for each machine in a month, the standby charge for the estate comes to 144.00 for that month. The complement chosen here is illustrative. The standby figures do not follow programme rank: the Campus Vending Network Service carries 55.00 for each machine while the Fresh Food Vending Service carries 72.00 and the Managed Vending & Kiosk Service 96.00.
